components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action catalyst for primary workflows and landing CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #06b6d4; color: #000; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(6,182,212,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #22d3ee; transform: scale(1.02); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subdued wireframe button for secondary navigation and modal triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #18181b; color: #e4e4e7; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(39,39,42,0.8); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #52525b; color: #fff; }

components.name: Telemetry Input
components.description: Dark recessed input field for domain names, auth credentials, and filter parameters.
components.css: .ds-input-field { background: #18181b; color: #ededed; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(63,63,70,0.8); border-radius: 8px; outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-field:focus { border-color: #06b6d4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #06b6d4; }

components.name: Live Status Pill
components.description: Continuous real-time telemetry indicator with bioluminescent pulse dot.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(8,51,68,0.5); color: #67e8f9; border: 1px solid rgba(14,116,144,0.6); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pulse-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22d3ee; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #22d3ee; }

components.description: Precision performance card featuring bold monospace numerals and trend badge.

components.name: Segmented Preset Bar
components.description: Horizon-fixed temporal range switcher for rapid 24h/7d/30d/12mo slicing.
components.css: .ds-preset-bar { display: inline-flex; background: rgba(24,24,27,0.9); border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 2px; gap: 2px; } .ds-preset-item { background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 6px; color: #a1a1aa; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-preset-item.active { background: #27272a; color: #22d3ee; font-weight: 600; } .ds-preset-item:hover:not(.active) { color: #ededed; }

narrative.overview:
Spidy treats web analytics not as commercial surveillance or marketing fluff, but as high-precision telemetry gathered from a deep-space vantage point. The interface is an astronomical cockpit: pitch-black canvases, muted obsidian instrument housings, and bioluminescent cyan vector projections that slice cleanly through the dark. Every element feels measured, silent, and mathematically sound.

Information is structured with rigorous density and immediate optical clarity. Rather than hiding data behind nested accordions or generic cards, Spidy showcases continuous geographic, diurnal, and navigational motion—rotating 3D WebGL globes, fluid Sankey journey rivers, and 7x24 diurnal matrices. The emotional tone is authoritative, honest, and calm: a nocturnal operations center monitoring live orbital data with zero corporate clutter.

Visual anti-references are strictly rejected: no pastel gradients, no rounded-blob cards, no playful illustration mascots, no light-mode default, and no low-contrast gray-on-white text. If an element does not convey spatial, temporal, or numerical truth, it does not belong in the viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Void Canvas & Phosphor Highlights: Pure pitch black (#000000) canvas paired with radiant Orbital Cyan (#06b6d4) indicators.
Dual Type Architecture: Modern geometric sans for structural headlines; crisp monospace with tabular figures for all data measurements and telemetry.
Hairline Precision Borders: 1px zinc outlines (#27272a) replacing heavy drop shadows to create clean, blueprint-like modularity.
Restrained Phosphor Glow: Soft 24px radiant halos reserved exclusively for live pulse blips, coordinate beacons, and primary catalysts.
Compact Instrument Ergonomics: Snappy 150ms transitions and 8px/12px corners that evoke precision aerospace controls.

rules.name: The Phosphor Contrast Rule
rules.body: Phosphor accents (Orbital Cyan #06b6d4, Growth Emerald #10b981) must strictly appear over pitch-black (#000000) or deep obsidian (#09090b) surfaces, never over mid-tone grays or low-contrast backgrounds.

rules.name: The Status Triad Rule
rules.body: Cyan (#06b6d4) represents live telemetry and primary navigation, Emerald (#10b981) signifies healthy growth and referrers, and Rose (#f43f5e) is reserved exclusively for destructive actions or metric degradation.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All dynamic numeric counts, percentages, and metrics must enforce tabular figures (tabular-nums) and monospaced typography (font-mono) to prevent visual jitter during live 5-second polling cycles.

rules.name: The Label Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Telemetry categories, section badges, and compact action triggers render in monospaced uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-wider or tracking-widest) at 11px or 12px.

rules.name: The Cockpit Density Rule
rules.body: Visualizations and breakdown telemetry prioritize compact, glanceable instrumentation over expansive whitespace; information density communicates technical rigor.

rules.name: The Sticky Horizon Rule
rules.body: The navigation bar and time range selector remain pinned at the top viewport edge with backdrop blur, ensuring temporal controls are perpetually accessible during deep scrolling.

rules.name: The Hairline Boundary Rule
rules.body: Containers and panels establish separation through 1px border-zinc-800/80 outlines rather than drop shadows. Resting surfaces never cast ambient shadows.

rules.name: The Phosphor Halo Rule
rules.body: Diffuse cyan halos (0 0 24px rgba(6,182,212,0.25)) are strictly reserved for live pulse beacons, interactive hero catalysts, and active coordinate blips.

rules.name: The Precision Bevel Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls employ an 8px radius; observational containers employ a 12px or 16px radius. Geometry remains crisp and controlled, never circular or bulbous.

dos: Do format all numerical telemetry, timestamps, and metric counts in font-mono with tabular-nums.
Do maintain a strict 1px hairline border (border-zinc-800/80) on all cards, panels, and floating containers.
Do reserve radiant cyan glows (shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(6,182,212,0.25)]) exclusively for primary action triggers and live beacons.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion across all WebGL canvas rotations and SVG stream transitions.
Do group dashboard telemetry into a consistent 2:1 column proportion (visual canvas vs. analytical table).
Do provide immediate hover feedback by brightening borders (border-zinc-700/80) and text (text-white).
donts: Don't introduce bright white canvas backgrounds, light-mode themes, or low-contrast gray text.
Don't use multi-color rainbow gradients, pastel cards, or decorative marketing illustrations.
Don't add heavy multi-stage drop shadows to resting cards or panels.
Don't use loose, oversized typography scales that compromise data density on dashboard screens.
Don't render raw IP addresses or personally identifiable information anywhere in the interface.
Don't introduce external font CDNs or third-party asset libraries.
